creator: Mike — Axiom/Mir
purpose: Local-first modular visual-effects creator, portable runtime, review and repair layer, sealed package format, and explicit adapter-contract foundation.

releaseFocus: raw validation before explicit normalization review
required package integrity and transactional import
cycle, depth, size, renderer, and CSS-binding bounds
canonical resolved visual intent and target-support reports

workingCapabilities: live local web scene rendering
typed parameter controls
guided traceable recipe creation
raw recipe validation before normalization
explicit review of normalization changes
derived and recursive composite creation
promoted child controls and binding validation
dependency graph and cycle rejection
bounded graph depth, package size, recipe layers, and generated layers
quality fallbacks and adaptive quality biases
performance load inspection and frame-history reporting
reduced-motion, high-contrast, large-text, and photosensitive-safe modes
bounded recipe repair with protection snapshots
non-mutating package review and transactional package import
local autosave with session-memory fallback
undo, redo, and named recipe-plus-custom-module snapshots
declarative package import and export with required SHA-256 integrity
built-in replacement protection
standalone HTML and Web Component export

Godot Theme and Unity UI Toolkit starter helpers
portable renderer-neutral runtime and local CLI
reproducible canonical-to-runtime generation
trustBoundaries: Imported community packages are declarative data and do not execute package-supplied code.
Sealed package integrity is required and verified before commit.
The entire package graph commits transactionally or not at all.
Raw recipes are validated before normalization changes are proposed.
Guide output remains an ordinary editable recipe.
Repair changes are reported and applied after a protection snapshot.
Snapshots preserve custom definitions with the recipe.
Adapters report implemented, approximated, contract-only, and unsupported operations.
Public licence and consent are never inferred.
Integrity detects modification but does not prove ownership or sharing rights.
notClaimed: native Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, After Effects, WebGL, PBR, or mobile renderer plugins
universal GLSL, HLSL, or WGSL compilation
fully isolated per-instance web render surfaces
public marketplace or remote automatic-update service
